[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec parse_notes (notes: List String) (result: List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match notes with
  | [] => result
  | note :: tail =>
    let beats := not_map note
    parse_notes tail (beats :: result)
parse_notes (string.splitOn " ") []
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma not_map_correctness
(note: String)
: not_map note = (match note with
  | "o" => 4
  | "o|" => 2
  | ".|" => 1
  | _ => 0)
:=
by
match note with
| "o" => rfl
| "o|" => rfl
| ".|" => rfl
| _ => rfl
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_spec_length: result.length = string.splitOn " ".length := by
  simp only [List.length, String.splitOn_length]
  simp only [string.splitOn]
  rfl
use h_spec_length
have h_spec_map: ∀ i < result.length, not_map (string.splitOn " ".get! i) = result.get! i := by
  simp only [forall_and_distrib, and_imp]
  intro i hi
  have h_i_in_bounds: i < result.length := by
    linarith
  have h_note := string.splitOn " ".get! i
  have h_note_map := not_map_correctness h_note
  simp [h_note_map]
use h_spec_map
[END]
